media:content.media:description: FLATBUSH, Brooklyn (WABC) -- First responders are on the scene of a reported partial building collapse in Brooklyn with people trapped, according to FDNY officials.The FDNY says it happened just after 4 p.m. at an apartment building located at 2625 Bedford Ave. between Newkirk and Flatbush avenues.
